(b) You could make little watercolor paintings of animals or nature scenes your friends love, and then turn them into cards or bookmarks. You could even paint a small scene from a safe, happy memory you share with them. That way, each gift feels really personal and special.
(c) You could make watercolor paintings of snowy landscapes or cozy winter scenes, and then turn them into cards or bookmarks. You could even paint a little picture of a cabin with warm lights. That way, each gift feels really personal and special.
(d) You could create handmade gifts by making small watercolor paintings of pretty flowers or landscapes, and then turning them into cards or bookmarks. You could even make a simple painting that would look nice framed. That way, each gift feels really personal and special.
